quests.title: Hilichurl Justice

dialogue.t: Mimi tomo, Odomu nye! Muhe mani?
I asked if it wanted any help from us, and sure enough, it seems like it does.
Dada odomu! Kundala dada! Kundala zido, mi dada! Muhe yeye!
Oh... It's basically saying that it wants us to help it... defeat a strong enemy.
Okay, the enemy's location is marked on the Map. Over to you!
Odomu tomo zido mi! Mi mani yeye! <color=#00E1FFFF>Unta nunu</color>!
<color=#00E1FFFF>Unta nunu</color>... Paimon thinks that has something to do with time. You should definitely check that in the handbook.

quests.description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues…
